main_body: A saddle sitting on a horizontal rack beam, with two legs and a hanging stirrup below. It is drawn as a side profile, with a pommel and cantle peak and a dip between them.
top_band: Peach saddle region from about row 9 to row 16 at the centre column. It reads as the saddle's side silhouette, not a horizontal surface. The rack beam below has only a 1-2 row lighter lip at rows 19-20.
evidence: The saddle is a profile cut-out whose peach area is a vertical flank with studs and stitching. The seat dip is shown as a silhouette, not a foreshortened top surface. The rack beam at rows 19-22 has only a thin lip, with no visible top face. The legs below are flat vertical posts. No horizontal surface is readable from above, so this fails as a side elevation.

style.evidence: The outlines are dark brown, tinted to the neighbouring material, which is good. The saddle uses about 3 peach tones and the wood about 3-4 browns. The peach body has large flat fills, and the legs are plain 2-3 colour columns. Texture is limited to a few stud dots and a yellow highlight. The tiles carry fewer colours than the stall and well references, so it looks thinner next to them.
